metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Shoulder Pain for Good
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix your shoulder pain FOR GOOD, and it's shown in a easy to follow step-by-step guide. 

First, quick shoulder pain relief muscle, ligament, and tendon (aka soft tissue) massage techniques are shown that may help release shoulder capsule and rotator cuff tightness, quickly helping to give shoulder pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS.

Second, two shoulder pain relief mobility exercises are demonstrated to help increase range of motion and mobility of the shoulder joint. This is particularly good for dull, ACHY shoulder pain. 

Third, shoulder and rotator cuff strengthening exercises are shown to build up the area in and around the shoulder, helping to future-proof it from injury and possibly lessen instances of pain.

All these stretches and exercises can be done AT HOME, don't require any special equipment, and be done ANYTIME you need an instant shoulder pain fix. Great part is, they're natural stretching movements that offer SAFE shoulder pain relief.

Watch now and get rid of shoulder pain for good!
